role_classification_rules.optional_historical_limitation_default: install generation version when source exists; ensure absent when source is absent

role_action_mapping.IDENTITY_REQUIRED: explicit per-file INSTALL / INHERIT / ABSENT + reason (declared above; no implicit default)
role_action_mapping.OPTIONAL_HISTORICAL_LIMITATION: INSTALL_GENERATION_VERSION when source exists; ENSURE_ABSENT when source is absent; preserve historical content verbatim

validation_contract.cd_file_identity_report: required at freeze after run-lock: path/blob/hash differences are recorded as DIAGNOSTIC/PROVENANCE; HUMAN GATE only on mandatory shared identity mismatch (BUSINESS_SNAPSHOT_ID / TASK_SPEC_ID / EVALUATION_ID); control-plane file identity difference alone never blocks formal C vs D comparison
validation_contract.c_d_frozen_tip: ARM_CONTROL_BASE_SHA = BENCHMARK_BASE_SHA (no synthetic commit; arm known from the run-locked manifest filename)

invocation_contract.pr_contract: OPEN NON-DRAFT; PR body contains native 'Closes #65'; DO NOT MERGE; base = frozen control-base branch
invocation_contract.closing_linkage: must come from ENSURE-LINKED-BUSINESS-BRANCH -> PR Development linkage promotion (closing keyword is native contract only, not an evidence source)

permission_discovery_identity.user_global_config: excluded from fixture closure (environment manifest, owned by #86)

mandatory_shared_identities.business_snapshot_id: identity of the frozen business snapshot; carried by the run-locked benchmark_base_sha field (BUSINESS_SNAPSHOT_ID)
mandatory_shared_identities.task_spec_id: identity of the frozen Task #65 workload spec; carried by the run-locked protocol_identity field (TASK_SPEC_ID)
mandatory_shared_identities.evaluation_id: identity of the formal C vs D evaluation definition; assigned at freeze via run-lock --evaluation-id (EVALUATION_ID)

per_arm_traceable_identities.environment_id: per-arm runtime environment identity (permission_discovery_identity / #86 environment manifest)

shared_identity_contract.formal_comparison_gate: formal C vs D comparison is valid iff BUSINESS_SNAPSHOT_ID, TASK_SPEC_ID, and EVALUATION_ID are identical across the compared Arms; any mismatch -> comparison invalid / Human Gate
shared_identity_contract.file_identity_disposition: control-plane file identity differences are DIAGNOSTIC / PROVENANCE; they never invalidate an Arm and never alone set a mandatory Human Gate or prohibit formal C vs D comparison
shared_identity_contract.rerun_policy: Arm-specific workflow/infrastructure fix -> rerun only that Arm; a shared component actually used by multiple Arms changed -> rerun affected Arms only; BUSINESS_SNAPSHOT_ID / TASK_SPEC_ID / EVALUATION_ID changed -> rerun all affected Arms; repository HEAD change alone never automatically invalidates prior valid Arm runs
